The '''Grand Coruscant Theatre''' was a theater on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the theatre presented [[Theepa]] on a [[Hyperdrive Tour]] to multiple planets including Coruscant and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
